verdict.rationale: Square's own Tap to Pay page says sellers can accept contactless cards, Apple Pay and other digital wallets in person with Tap to Pay on iPhone, and the developer docs include a matching Mobile Payments SDK Tap to Pay on iPhone page. That is the core of phone-based contactless acceptance. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that no reader purchase is needed, evidence of Tap to Pay on Android or other off-the-shelf phones, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept contactless card payments on an off-the-shelf phone (Tap to Pay) without buying a reader

citations.quote: Accept contactless cards, Apple Pay, and other digital wallets in person with Tap to Pay on iPhone.
